body:
The compatibility could be handled by `_get()` method. Check for the old name and return the new setting instead. Though it incurs a cost when getting any setting and we don't do that with any other setting.

In the past the old settings were simply removed. It does not break the API in a serious way, but in this case people might be using the value in plugins, so not sure. For now maybe reuse the box settings and they can be renamed in a follow-up.
